answer_1.quote: We introduce the task of Synchronized Video Storytelling, which aims to generate synchronized narrations for videos.

answer_2.quote: Following , we evaluate the generated narrations with NLP metrics such as BLEU , METEOR (Banerjee and Lavie, 2005), and CIDEr .

answer_3.quote: When generating stories controlled by a predefined storyline, we utilize GPT-4 to assess the controllable accuracy of the script labels.

answer_4.quote: We randomly sample 30 stories and ask 13 advertisers to conduct the evaluation.
answer_4.guideline: We compare our models with the few-shot generation results of existing powerful LLMs... All metrics are rated from 0 to 3.
